pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high-contrast, jagged edges on the neck and more rounded boundaries on the posterior flank. The spatial area of patches decreases from the mid-section toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial space forming three- and four-point junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is widest on the mid-flank and narrows significantly at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A distinct, serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, characterized by a repeating pattern of short, vertical hair tufts creating a jagged geometric contrast against the background.
